options_explained.use: A winding light brown path connects six stations, with flour spots and eggshell line art on both sides of the road.

steps.count: Vivid magenta background steals the scene.
items: 01 Separate Eggs & Weighing: Clean and Dry Egg Whites Bowl, Low Gluten Flour + Milk + Oil in Another Bowl (Illustrative)
02 Make Egg Yolk Mixture: First Emulsify Liquid, Then Sift Flour, Mix in a Z Shape to Avoid Dry Powder
03 Whipping Egg Whites: Add Sugar Gradually (Illustrative), Until Moisture is Slightly Dry with Small Hook (Text Description)
04 Folding: 1/3 egg white into the egg yolk mixture, then pour back into the egg white bowl, folding from the bottom within 20 times (concept)
05 Pouring & shaking bubbles: Seven to eight tenths full, gently shake, place in preheated oven (temperature text remains 'adjust according to own oven')
06 Inversion after baking: Unmold after completely cooling; most failures are due to egg whites and folding (a word of encouragement)
